title: Repeated edits of visible WordPress theme words require proven whole-output composition
steps: Advertise whole-output composition and inspect the second visible edit of a prior rendered-word replacement.
Exercise malformed markers and markers from a plugin without composition capability, then run shipped build-fence scenarios with real turn identity.
expect: The caller forwards the visible before/after words and the proven replaces_rule marker without reverse-mapping raw words.
Malformed or unadvertised markers refuse without mutation; old plugins retain their original wire shape.
Assigned build turns refuse questions/approvals while ordinary owner turns preserve their confirmation paths.
evidence: Local Levain turn19: normal content.replace, visitor read, apply.revert, visitor read and final composed edit succeeded. PHP plugin suite 3315 PASS.
fence: Plugin-issued whole-output provenance is mandatory and caller checks capability, marker and observed anchors/counts.

tests: a whole-output capable plugin receives the visible edit with its proven raw rule identity
unproven composition candidates never dispatch a write (capability false)
unproven composition candidates never dispatch a write (capability true)
